INCEPTRIX 3.0 – Innovations Begin for a Better Nation

19th–20th February 2027 | JAIN (Deemed-to-be-University), Bengaluru

INCEPTRIX 3.0 is the flagship innovation and technology hackathon organised by the Tech Council, Faculty of Engineering & Technology, JAIN (Deemed-to-be-University), Bengaluru. Building upon the success of its previous editions, INCEPTRIX returns with a vision to bring together aspiring innovators, developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform creative ideas into impactful technological solutions.

With a total prize pool of ₹2,50,000, INCEPTRIX 3.0 offers participants an opportunity to tackle real-world challenges, explore emerging technologies, collaborate with like-minded individuals, and demonstrate their technical capabilities.

The hackathon follows a structured two-round format:

ROUND 1 – ONLINE IDEA SUBMISSION (FREE)

Teams are required to register and submit their innovative ideas through a structured presentation outlining the problem statement, proposed solution, technology stack, feasibility, and implementation approach.

Registration for Round 1 is absolutely FREE. No payment is required to register or submit your idea.

  • Registration Opens: 1st November 2026
  • Submission Deadline: 24th December 2026
  • Finalist Announcement: 10th January 2027

ROUND 2 – ON-GROUND FINAL HACKATHON

Shortlisted teams from Round 1 will advance to the final on-ground hackathon. Selected teams must complete their final-round registration by paying a participation fee of ₹1,000 per team.

  • Final Round Registration: 11th–20th January 2027
  • Hackathon Dates: 19th–20th February 2027
  • Venue: JAIN (Deemed-to-be-University), Bengaluru.

TEAM REQUIREMENTS

  • Team size: 4–5 members.
  • At least one female participant is mandatory in every team.
  • Submissions must demonstrate originality, innovation, and practical relevance.

WHY PARTICIPATE?

  • Apply technical knowledge to real-world challenges.
  • Gain insights through expert evaluation and mentorship.
  • Collaborate with innovators from diverse backgrounds.
  • Strengthen technical, analytical, and presentation skills.
  • Compete for a prize pool of ₹2,50,000.

Join INCEPTRIX 3.0 and take your ideas beyond imagination. Build solutions, challenge possibilities, and become a part of an innovation-driven community.

Your idea. Your innovation. Your opportunity.

Organised by:
Tech Council, Faculty of Engineering & Technology
JAIN (Deemed-to-be-University), Bengaluru.
